name: Bardic Inspiration

description.content: While idle, you can perform, empowering all Survivors within [16m] for up to [15s]. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. Roll a d20:
If you complete the performance, this effect ends after [90s]. Cooldown: [90s].

quote: "Listen closely! I'm about to save your life!" -Aestri
